text.en:
Any person who shall maintain a cockpit for the fighting of cocks, or who shall engage in
cockfighting in a cockpit, or who shall attend as a spectator of cockfighting in a cockpit, on any day when
cockfighting is not lawfully licensed to take place by the municipality in which the cockpit is situate, shall he
punished by a fine not exceeding two hundred dollars, in money of the United States, or by imprisonment not
exceeding six months, or both, in the discretion of the court.

Any person who shall maintain or take part in a game of chance in a cockpit, whether the cockpit
he lawfully licensed or, not, shall be punished by a fine not exceeding two hundred dollars, in money of the
United States, or by imprisonment for not exceeding six months, or both, in the discretion of the court.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 15, 1902.
